summary.zh: 学生支持代表未加入玩家阵营的普通学生对组织的整体态度。它反映校园外围舆论，而不是组织内部稳定。
summary.en: Student Support represents the overall attitude of students outside the player faction. It reflects the wider campus mood rather than internal stability.

items.zh: 顶部 HUD 的学生支持来自未加入玩家阵营学生的平均信任度。
items.en: The top HUD student support value comes from the average trust of students outside the player faction.

items.zh: 学生支持越高，说明外围学生更容易接受组织理念。
items.en: Higher student support means the wider student body is more receptive to the organization.

items.zh: 学生支持不同于稳定度，稳定度更偏向组织内部成员。
items.en: Student support is different from stability, which focuses on internal members.

items.zh: 宣传、集会和区域行动可能逐步提高学生支持。
items.en: Propaganda, rallies, and region actions may gradually increase student support.

items.zh: 失败的邀请、过度压榨或不受欢迎的行动可能降低学生支持。
items.en: Failed invitations, exploitation, or unpopular actions may reduce student support.

items.zh: 高学生支持可以让后续招募和舆论扩张更顺利。
items.en: High student support can make future recruitment and opinion growth smoother.
